# aidial_file_alias (Data Source)

Reads an alias defined in DIAL Core's static (file) configuration. Aliases stored in resource storage are read by `aidial_alias`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An alias defined in DIAL Core's static (file) configuration.
data "aidial_file_alias" "fast_chat" {
  name = "fast-chat"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the alias in DIAL Core's static configuration.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Alias description.
- `description_keywords` (Set of String) Keywords that help find the alias by description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable alias name.
- `display_version` (String) Version shown for the alias.
- `icon_url` (String) URL of the alias icon.
- `intro` (String) Introductory text shown for the alias.
- `present_as` (String) What the alias is shown as: `model`, `application` or `toolset`.
- `target_path` (String) The deployment the alias points at: `models/<name>`, `applications/<name>` or `toolsets/<name>`.
- `user_roles` (Set of String) Roles allowed to use the alias.
